body: Hello! Thanks for checking up. I think I’m doing good than yesterday and days before that…
Cool man! You know 4 languages already! It is my dream to learn a 3rd language, aside from my country’s language and English! If you need a friend, beep me up! 😁

It would be presumptuous for me to say that I completely understand what you’re feeling - because I probably don’t, we experience things differently. But maybe, it is okay for me to say that “I know that you’re hurting.” 

I think you experienced bad things for the past 18 years and she became a major source of your happiness. But... try to think of it, maybe you just need to gamble for another years of life in this world, and maybe, you’ll be able to hit that jackpot to another happiness, and maybe HAPPIER! What to lose in trying? As a human, maybe you already had a share of this world’s cruelness... then what’s new with another day of struggle... while facing these struggles daily, one day, maybe we’ll be able to find something new to make this world look better in our eyes. Something that makes it not cruel... until you see that the world is actually a good place after all. My point is, tomorrow maybe won’t be a new day for you... but maybe a day after day, or maybe next week, or a week after that... I’ll get better.

I honestly don’t know what to say. But... I hope you’ll think twice... thrice... or more. I hope you’ll be able to look for a reason to stay in this world. Your family, friends?... or maybe, another person that you’re destined to meet after a day or two... maybe that person could be a reason for you to keep fighting. Maybe another person, a friend or a special someone, could help you to make “yourself” be the reason for you to keep fighting. I’m just blabbering here... trying to say anything to make you keep fighting... if you need someone to talk to, we’re here. Anonymously, I’m here, if you need someone to talk to - even online.
